title: Treasury coupon announcement (2Y + 5Y + 7Y notes, 2Y FRN reopening, 52-week and 13/26/6-week bills) — the Thanksgiving-week block, announced two hours before the 10Y TIPS auction
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-08 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) by the treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19 initial research, text layer decompressed stream-by-stream and re-tokenised into 213 (security, announce, auction, settle) rows. EIGHT rows carry announce date `Thursday, November 19, 2026`: `13-Week BILL` and `26-Week BILL` and `2-Year NOTE` (auction Monday, November 23, 2026), `6-Week BILL` and `52-Week BILL` and `2-Year FRN R` and `5-Year NOTE` (auction Tuesday, November 24, 2026), and `7-Year NOTE` (auction Wednesday, November 25, 2026). ~11:00am ET is this series' standing convention, inherited from the sibling coupon-announcement ledgers, and is NOT separately sourced. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep. Checked 2026-09-08
notes: DISCOVERED during the treasury-10y-tips-2026-11-19 never-assessed initial research (2026-09-08), and proposed because it SHARES A SESSION WITH ITS PROPOSER: this announcement lands ~11:00 ET and the 10-Year TIPS second reopening prices at 1:00pm ET the same day, so the entire Thanksgiving-week nominal coupon block is on the tape two hours before the TIPS bidding deadline. MEASURED AND NOT A VETERANS DAY ARTIFACT, which is the reason it is worth tracking rather than noting: pulling every 2-Year note auction since 2019 from fiscaldata auctions_query (n=200, sorted -auction_date) and reading its `announcemt_date`, the month-end 2-Year announcement has fallen on the SAME SESSION as the 10-Year TIPS November second reopening in 6 of the 7 years 2019-2025 (2019-11-21, 2020-11-19, 2021-11-18, 2022-11-17, 2024-11-21, 2025-11-20; the one exception is 2023, where the TIPS auctioned 11-21 and the 2-Year was announced 11-22). 2026 makes it 7 of 8. THE NATURAL OWNER OF FOUR UNTRACKED COUPON AUCTIONS: the 2-Year note (11-23), 5-Year note (11-24), 2-Year FRN reopening (11-24) and 7-Year note (11-25) are all sized and announced here, and this lane deliberately did NOT file them separately — the same discipline the treasury-coupon-announcement-2026-11-12 ledger applied when it declined to file the 3Y 11-09 and 10Y 11-10 refunding legs because their natural owner was treasury-refunding-2026-11-04. SIZE EXPECTATION, for whoever researches it: on the grid this is 2Y $69B, 5Y $70B, 7Y $44B, 2Y FRN reopening $28B — no nominal coupon or FRN size has changed anywhere since April 2024 (~29 months, ten refundings), a base rate derived in full by the 11-12 sibling. The genuinely open numbers are the BILLS, where sb0590 reserves the flexibility in writing. Proposed as an estimate; symbols: [] and no house playbook is rates-keyed, so nothing here licenses an entry.
